card.name: Just before the word hours
card.fires_on: The space or number just before a count of hours in dosing or timing text, such as 12, 24 or 48 followed by hours. It also fires on a word like within or q that leads into an hour count.

modes.label: Space before a number of hours
modes.description: The gap or number slot right before a figure that will be followed by hours or an hour-based interval.

modes.label: Number or word leading into hours
modes.description: A digit or timing word such as within or q that comes just before an hour count.
modes.example: Re-evaluate eGFR 4<<8>> hours after the imaging procedure

card.writes: It promotes hour-unit words such as hours and hour, so the model predicts that unit next.
card.plain: It fires when the text is about to give a time in hours, such as within 12 hours or every 24 hours.
